How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude specific countries due to regulatory or risk concerns. However, this leaves creators in these countries without a reliable means of selling their digital products. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to be accessible to anyone, regardless of their location, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer. This approach enables creators to operate independently, without relying on platforms that may not support their region.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When using traditional payment gateways, creators face transaction fees, which can eat into their profit margins. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH, offers a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, with no KYC requirements and no need for buyers to create an account. Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With traditional platforms, creators often have limited control over their store and products. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, provides creators with full ownership and automation capabilities, allowing them to manage their store and deliver products instantly. This approach also enables creators to scale their business more efficiently, without relying on third-party platforms.
